dedupe_keys.name: adriatic offshore platform gnss position time series

description: Palano and colleagues publish three-dimensional GNSS coordinate time series from 37 stations on offshore platforms and nearby onshore industrial sites in the Adriatic region. The public PANGAEA repository is CC BY 4.0 and provides ASCII position files with offset and processing information. Coverage is 37 stations in the Adriatic region. These series can help calibrate vertical-motion or ground-stability inputs for offshore asset exposure and monitoring simulations. A caveat is that GNSS positions depend on reference frame, station equipment and geodetic processing software; an apparent platform trend is not automatically structural degradation. The article reports outputs from Bernese, GAMIT/GLOBK and GIPSY processing and manually picked offsets. Coverage differs by station and must be checked in selected files before time-series comparison. I read the own PANGAEA and DataCite metadata plus article Data Records without downloading the position series, assessing offsets or combining stations. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
